svg.aria-label: Where combined sewer mains are in Vancouver, from City open data
svg.text: Cells where most mapped sewer length is combined (sewage + stormwater in one pipe)
Mapped mains in the City of Vancouver open dataset "Sewer mains" (accessed Oct 17, 2026), grouped into ~300 m cells. Lengths computed from the line geometry.
These dataset totals are not the City's reported 536 km figure used on this site; the map shows where, not the official count.
